name: Sonja Shaw
title: President, Chino Valley Unified School District Board; candidate for Superintendent of Public Instruction (2026)
district: Chino Valley Unified School District Board of Education
background: Shaw is a Chino native who began attending school-board meetings during pandemic-era school closures and mandates. She was elected to the Chino Valley Unified board and became its president in 2022. (Ballotpedia candidate survey)

Under her leadership the board adopted a parental-notification policy on student gender identity that drew a lawsuit from Attorney General Rob Bonta. In 2023 she presided over a meeting at which then-Superintendent Tony Thurmond was escorted out during a debate over transgender students' rights. She placed first in the June 2, 2026 primary with 22.64%. (CalMatters; Ballotpedia)
